about: Project page and coordinator cards: iOS/web/Android parity (board docs/mocks/ios-project-page-and-coordinator-cards/ board-4,
criterion 7). Two of the three cards a coordinator conversation draws after a project starts, with the words each says. The
third, the criteria-decision receipt, has its own fixture (criteria-decision-receipt.fixture.json).
Web reads it in src/web/src/components/CoordinatorStartCards.fixture.test.tsx, Android in
`startReceipts`: a recorded confirmation (`GET /projects/:id/acceptance/confirmation` -> `confirmation`) drawn as its receipt
line (web `runSettingsParts`, OrbitKit `RunSettings.parts`) joined with " · ", null where the record started nothing.
`expected.stamp` is read at `clock` (`now`, `timeZone`, `locale`), the receipt-time rule of project-page-labels.fixture.json.
`projectStarted`: the `projectStarted` payload a user turn carries (web `parseProjectStarted` / `ProjectStartedCard`, OrbitKit
`ProjectStarted` / `ProjectStartedCardView`). `expected.meta` is the foot line without its relative time. `expected.tasks` are
the titles listed before the fold opens, `expected.toggle` the fold's control (null where every listed task shows) and
